RelayTower01Ext02 |refid ={{ID|00261a3b}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMountain}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|ChallengeLocTypeRelayStation}} |edid =LocMountainsRelayTower01Location }} '''Relay tower EL-B1-02''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Savage Divide]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== This relay tower at the end of a dirt road is fenced-in and surrounded by fallen trees and plants such as [[Firecracker berry|firecracker berries]]. An [[off-road vehicle]] is parked outside of the building. A detached door is used as a ramp to access the facility, which is guarded by [[Automated turret (Fallout 76)|laser turrets]] and the [[Scorched]]. Inside, there is a number of shelves and other storage amid the mostly ruined interior. There are two terminals here, one for the emergency management system relay and the other on its opposite side, a maintenance personnel terminal. Five cots line the northern wall, with some [[Footlocker (Fallout 76)|footlockers]] accompanying them. Back outside, there is a staircase that can be used to access the roof, though there is nothing of note up top. ==Notable loot== * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - Inside the relay station, against the central pillar, on the metal desk next to the maintenance personnel terminal. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - Inside the relay station, against the western wall, on top of a blue console. * [[Stealth Boy (Fallout 76)|Stealth Boy]] - Inside the relay station, on a cot with a locked footlocker. ==Related quest== * [[Request Government Air Drop]]: A [[US government supply requisition]] holotape can be used in the relay tower terminal. ==Appearances== Relay tower EL-B1-02 appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== F76 Relay Tower EL-B1-02.png {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Savage Divide locations]] [[ru:Релейная вышка EL-B1-02]]

{{Infobox location |games =FO76, FO76OW |type =unmarked |image =FO76 Watoga Towers.png |map marker =(nearest: [[Watoga Civic Center]]) |map marker image =Watoga map.png |signage =FO76 Watoga Towers new.png |part of =[[Watoga]]
[[Cranberry Bog]], [[Appalachia]] |leaders = |merchants = |sections =Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor |factions =[[Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout 76)|Brotherhood of Steel]] |owners =[[Vernon Dodge]] |creatures = |robots = |quests =[[Breaking Radio Silence]] |terminal =[[Watoga Towers terminal entries|Terminal]] |cell name =WatogaTowers01 |edid =LocCranberryWatogaTowersInteriorLocation |formid ={{ID|00590ab3}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionCranberryBog}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeInteriorCell}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScalePOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWealthy}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeInstancedCell}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |tinkering =yes}} }} '''Watoga Towers''' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the town of [[Watoga]] in the [[Cranberry Bog]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Advertised as "Watoga's Home of Tomorrow,"Vernon Dodge: ''"{{Tooltip|Mind the smell. Hard to air the place out. "Watoga's Home of Tomorrow" my ass.|Spiteful}}"''
([[Vernon Dodge/Dialogue|Vernon Dodge's dialogue]]) Watoga Towers served as one of the many futuristic residences for Watoga's elite residents. Shortly after the [[Great War]], [[Vernon Dodge]] managed to access the tower elevator and made a home for himself for approximately three weeks.[[Watoga Towers terminal entries#moving on|Watoga Towers terminal entries; terminal, moving on]] ==Layout== Watoga Towers is located directly east of the [[Watoga Civic Center]]. There are several voting stations located outside of the building. The interior is accessed by going up a flight of stairs that face the nearby creek. There is an elevator that will bring the player character to the third floor. The elevator opens to a small lobby area with green walls. Directly in front of the elevator is a door that opens to Initiate Dodge's room. The apartment has several [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk items]] and containers that can be freely looted. To the right is a [[tinker's workbench]] and a door to a messy, ruined bathroom with little of note. In one corner is a set of terminals and consoles; to the left of the consoles is a door that leads into a bedroom. The bedroom has a [[Sleeping bag (Fallout 76)|sleeping bag]] but has also been converted into storage for some machinery. Another corner has a small kitchen area, and in the center is the dining table and the small satellite dish on which Initiate Dodge is leaning. There is a [[scorchbeast nest]] affixed to the roof. ==Notes== Watoga Towers' exterior was in the game at launch, though the third floor interior was added in [[Fallout 76 patch 1.4.0.20|patch 22]]. ==Appearances== Watoga Towers appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]'', and was expanded upon in the ''[[One Wasteland For All]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]]. ==Gallery== FO76 Watoga SP 13.png|Exterior FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 01.png|Apartment 3B entrance FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 02.png|[[Vernon Dodge]] FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 03.png|Bathroom FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 04.png|Bedroom dresser FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 05.png|Bedroom machinery and storage FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 06.png|Brotherhood sign FO76OW Watoga Towers - 3rd Floor 07.png|Dodge's desk and a [[tinker's workbench]] ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Watoga locations]] [[fr:Tours de Watoga]] [[ru:Вышки Ватоги]]

The '''bellhop''' is a unique [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] found at the [[Pleasant Valley Ski Resort]] {{in|FO76}}.     

==Background==
This Protectron facilitates the exchange of [[Pleasant Valley claim ticket]]s for random rewards, such as clothes, pre-War money, and junk that can be scrapped.
